scope: Read-only ground audit. Source shoe alpha is mapped through actual original UV triangles onto independently evaluated source3D/LBS frames. Reports visible-foot contour and separately the original lower sole edge; never substitutes a transparent mesh bounding vertex for a sole.

sampling.filter: bilinear alpha at texel centers, before mip LOD; source UV triangle clips applied
sampling.visible_foot_region: source cropped texture y>=60, from existing observed instep/heel/sole anchors
sampling.model_oracle: Original non-secondary frames, previously checked against actual runtime3D/LBS within3.1e-5 pixels. Foot chains are not affected by DynamicBone cloth/hair components.

arena_ground_shadow.native_contact_shadow: Empty Node2D, no shoe-contact drawing and no has_contact_shadow method; actual arena uses its fixed fallback ellipse.

interpretation: Positive clearance means visible shoe alpha above the actor foot origin. Positive gap to shadow top is visible separation from the fixed arena ellipse. RootY is separate from yifu/leg local animation. Original game ground correction and full Animator are not included in these source frame data.
measurement_coordinate_space: Uncompensated source-local baseline after old fixed Idle0 mesh offset, before grounding_profile whole-actor display translation; see corrected actual native_root_smoke.details.visible_sole_grounding.
